subject: maths
title: Separable Variables
welcome_lead: Separate variables to integrate both sides and solve ODEs analytically.
meta_desc: HL Maths adventure on solving separable first-order differential equations.
final_note: Separate variables, integrate, then apply initial conditions!

concepts.def: Ordinary differential equation involves one variable.
dy/dx = f(x) g(y) splits as g(y)^-1 dy = f(x) dx.
Found by applying initial condition y(x_0) = y_0.
dy/dt = ky gives y = y_0 e^(kt).
dy/dt = ky(1 - y/L) bounded by carrying capacity L.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Solve dy/dx = xy.

dy/y = x dx, so ln|y| = x^2/2 + C, giving y = A e^(x^2/2).

With y(0) = 5, find A.

5 = A e^0 = A, so y = 5 e^(x^2/2).

Solve dy/dt = -3y, y(0) = 10.

y = 10 e^(-3t), the classic decay curve.
